summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests EIK1004 (IMP1707), a PARP1 selective inhibitor, in people with advanced solid tumors, including breast, ovarian, prostate, and pancreatic cancer with certain changes in homologous recombination repair genes. The study drug is taken by mouth as tablets once daily, except for a single-dose period, with doses increasing until progressive disease or the participant stops; the total length of treatment is not stated beyond that. The study measures safety and tolerability and also evaluates preliminary activity, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa EIK1004 (IMP1707), un inhibidor selectivo de PARP1, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados, incluidos cáncer de mama, de ovario, de próstata y de páncreas con ciertos cambios en genes de reparación por recombinación homóloga. El medicamento del estudio se toma por vía oral en forma de tabletas una vez al día, excepto durante un período de dosis única, y las dosis aumentan hasta que la enfermedad progrese o el participante deje el tratamiento; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica más allá de eso. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad y también evalúa la actividad preliminar, y la medida de resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Adults aged 18 to 89 years with advanced solid tumors.
Breast cancer, HER2-negative, after prior chemotherapy; hormonal therapy first if hormone receptor-positive.
Ovarian, fallopian tube or peritoneal cancer after at least one prior platinum-based chemotherapy for advanced disease.
Metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer on ongoing hormone suppression therapy, with up to one prior taxane line.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1, life expectancy of at least 12 weeks, and known deleterious or suspected deleterious HRR gene mutations.
not_for: Prior use of a PARP1 selective inhibitor.
Investigational or approved anti-cancer therapy within 28 days before the first dose.
Mean resting QTcF above 470 ms or below 340 ms.
Active hepatitis B or C infection.
Untreated brain lesions larger than 2.0 cm, symptomatic leptomeningeal disease, or poorly controlled seizures.
